Chapter 6441: Peng’S Immensity

Chapter 6441: Peng’s Immensity

Conjured weapons assumed a special formation to trap North Kun God.

“Devil Abyss!” Devil roared and turned into an abyss. Countless devils climbed out, preparing to drag North Kun God into the darkness.

“Eternal Will.” Human stood still while enjoying the prayers and blessings of his subjects. A path of eternal life unfolded toward North Kun God, absorbing his vitality and lifespan.

The combined attacks aimed to bypass the kun peng to kill its master. Seventy-two Origin Ancesto joined the fray.

His wings lit up the battlefield as more lightning bolts coursed through him. Upon full saturation, the power of judgment turned his wings into a snow-white saber to deliver the wrath of the high heaven.

“Executor Lightningblade!” He roared and slashed forward. The tribulation power cut through the dream world to obliterate the kun peng.

Four primal ancestors at the eternal stage possessed immense destructive potential, enough to crush Gold VIllage or Paramount.

“Damn!” No one could get up from the ground including emperors and desolate gods. The other primal gods and heaven-slayers were in awe.

“Peng’s Immensity!” North Kun God turned the kun peng into a seal larger than heaven and earth, encompassing Old World, not just the dream world. The attacks simply couldn’t get through before being pulverized.

The attackers felt something overwhelming them, forcing them to react defensively.

“Bam!” They still vomited blood from the pressure, being sent flying through space and struggling to stabilize.

“The gap is insurmountable.” Big shots in the audience gasped.

“Supreme.” The attackers understood immediately.

North Kun God had seen the door to the supreme realm, on the verge of becoming a supreme overlord. Most importantly, he would be the first heaven-slayer to do so. As the first, his potential far exceeded anyone later down the line.

The same thing occurred with the heaven-slayers. Fairy Companions were the first ones so they had advantages compared to other heaven-slayers.

“The four of you are not enough.” North Kun God glared at them, proving his superiority.

“Heaven-slayers can get this strong?” Primal ancestors in the crowd couldn’t believe it; their breathing became erratic.

In theory, the return path was one stage higher than eternal. However, his battle prowess was far more expensive.

“The era of the heaven-slayers is here?” Others on this path saw hope. Perhaps one day they would become more powerful than emperors and primal ancestors.

“He saw the door.” A primal ancestor whispered: “Everlasting Jiang and Fardao’s death was not in vain, their descendants saw the way to break through.”

“Again?” North Kun God took one step forward.

The primal ancestors became startled. In terms of age, North Kun God was only a junior but now, he had reached a level capable of threatening them.

“North Kun God, I’m afraid you won’t leave this place alive today.” The origin ancestor uttered coldly.

“Certainly not to your hands.” North Kun God responded.

“Fellow Daoist, there’s no need for escalation.” A calm voice answered. The speaker seemed to have been here the entire time.

North Kun God turned around; his eyes fixated on a certain place in the dream world.

The speaker finally appeared and repelled North Kun God’s aura. His rhythms were in tune with nature so others couldn’t detect his presence.

“Tenacious.” North Kun God was not surprised to see him.

“Tenacious of God Frontier.” Those seeing him for the first time were surprised.

His title hasn’t been spoken for a long time since he hadn’t appeared in recent eras.
